prompts.selectionReason: Near-cutoff test of whether enormous cosmological consequences plus pursuit outrank relationship-centered stakes, despite a less intimate opening.
Near-cutoff test of tolerance for an idea-forward, aphoristic telepathy premise: empathy, privacy, and personhood align strongly, but a protagonist and immediate conflict are absent.
Near-cutoff romance and consent probe: intentional divine emotion modification creates moral choice and intimacy, but may feel coercive or plot-prescriptive.
Tests appetite for fairy-tale romance and class conspiracy, where false history and intimate stakes compete with a familiar true-love trope.
Tests preference for a precise countdown and hidden-rule mystery with global stakes versus character-first premises; the mundane post-office instruction gives it an unusual engine.
Tests whether identity and duty questions in a dry, low-conflict robot mind-swap compel when both characters adapt competently rather than escalating.
Tests cozy supernatural ensemble appeal: care relationships and varied patients offer discovery, but the premise favors episodic worldbuilding over a forced moral choice.
Midrank tone probe for broad comedy: personified inner conflict and addiction have emotional potential, but the old-married-couple gag may dominate.
Lower-rank exploration of atmospheric minimalism and non-speculative ambiguity; reveals whether open character space can compensate for almost no stated stakes.
Deep-rank blind-spot check: afterlife and time displacement match strong seed motifs, while vague rules and no viewpoint test tolerance for underdefined premises.
